newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Abengoa sees dividend at least 30 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Abengoa sees dividend at least 30 pct.

text.p: Spain's applied engineering and equipment firm Abengoa said it will dedicate more than 30 percent of earnings to dividends, in an interview published on Monday by financial daily Expansion.

Felipe and Javier Benjumea, co-presidents of the firm, which will be listed on the Spanish bourse from November 29, after an initial public offering (IPO) of a 33 percent stake, said Abengoa would dedicate 30 to 35 percent as long as investment permits it.
The company closed 1995 with earnings of 906 million pesetas and said it expected to end 1996 with earnings at 2.35 billion pesetas.
The final price of the issue will be set on November 27, between 3,900 and 4,300 pesetas per share, according to the prospectus.
